fixed_statement:
Let \(A\) be a unital \(C^*\)-algebra, let \(\phi\) be a state on \(A\), and let \(p\in A\) be a projection with \(\phi(p)=1\).

Then
\[
\phi(a)=\phi(pap)
\qquad\text{for every }a\in A.
\]
fixed_proof:
Decomposing
\[
a=pap+pae+eap+eae,
\]
and applying \(\phi\), all terms except \(pap\) vanish. Hence \(\phi(a)=\phi(pap)\).
